notes: Finding people round-based with one seeker and a timer is hide-and-seek, so Party & Casual and its Childhood Game preset. The author's whole map is one big arcade, so I took interior-single from the shared catalogue over the genre's default space-bounded: both route the same, but interior-single states the thing that matters to the build, that the venue is the entire map with no exterior to generate and no inside-outside transition to link, which keeps it off P3. obstacle-maze was dropped because a big arcade was described as a place rather than a warren, and cover-los carries the dense rows of cabinets that do the sightline-breaking work here. Without a user I decided the between-rounds gathering space is the arcade's own entrance floor rather than a separate lobby, so nothing needs staging; the neon retro palette is art direction rather than an option.
